QuestInfo.name: Donate Your Notebook
QuestInfo.0: I wonder what all the commotion is about. Rumor has it that there's a race going on. The team that collects the most Notebooks will win. The reward is also said to be very nice...
QuestInfo.1: I'm really anxious to find out which team is winning. I gotta get more players involved to win this race!
QuestInfo.2: I gave Maple Administrator the Notebook. She seemed very ecstatic, as if it was for him... seriously, what did she do with all those notebooks?

0.0: Green Slime, Kru, The Book Ghost, Blue Kentaurus are dropping Notebooks. Collect as much as you can and bring them back to me. The team that collects the most will be rewarded.
0.1: Scania, Kradia, Bellocan is Team A; Bera, Khaini, Yellonde is Team B; and Broa, Windia, Mardia is Team C.

yes.0: You have made the right decision! Be aware that the Notebooks are dropped at a low rate. Good luck!

no.0: Come back again later if you feel like you're missing out on all the fun.
